title: git kura tools install metadata
description: Schema for <git-common-dir>/kura/tools/installed.json, the record of git-kura managed tool components installed in this repository.

components.description: Map from component ID to its install metadata entry.

component.description: The component ID this entry describes.

sourceAssetId.description: Identifier of the source asset within the tools archive.

releaseVersion.description: git-kura release version the asset was taken from.

releaseAssetName.description: Name of the tools release asset archive.

destinationPath.description: Filesystem path or config key the component manages.

installedVersion.description: Version recorded for the installed component.

checksum.description: Checksum of the managed file or value, used to detect external modification.

managedMode.description: Whether the component manages a file or a git config value.

componentMetadata.description: Component-specific metadata opaque to the framework.

updatedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of the most recent install/update.
